no_api_findings.finding: The versioned Node.js API inventory has no Matrix Market decoder. fs.readFile and Buffer return data but do not interpret Matrix Market headers, dimensions, or entries. No documented format-aware built-in API was available to run against the control.
Blob and FileReader expose local bytes or text, but the File API defines no Matrix Market parser. No documented format-aware browser API was available to run against the control.

limit: This inventory covers Node.js 26.10.0 core and the browser File API, not third-party npm packages or application-specific readers.
